summary_1line: Iravat, Arjuna’s Naga-born son, joins the Kurukshetra battle, devastates Sakuni’s brothers and cavalry despite being surrounded and heavily wounded.

image_candidates.scene_text: Iravat, bleeding and on foot with sword and shield, whirls among mounted Gandhara princes, severing their arms as golden weapons fall to the blood-soaked field.
Two great cavalry forces collide as swift, gold-adorned horses crash chest to chest, riders slashing while the battlefield fills with dust and chaos.
In Indra’s celestial court, Arjuna embraces Iravat, the son he had not seen since the Naga princess bore him in the serpent realm.
